title: Engineering Manager, Access Control
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About This Role

At Verkada, we’re building the operating system for the physical world. Our Access Control team develops the software that securely manages millions of door events every day, connecting cloud services, mobile apps, web applications, and edge hardware into a seamless customer experience.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager who enjoys building products, growing engineers, and solving difficult technical problems. This role is ideal for someone who has spent years writing production software and now wants to multiply their impact by leading a high-performing engineering team.

What You'll Do

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of frontend and backend software engineers through coaching, regular feedback, career development, and hiring.

• Own delivery for major customer-facing initiatives from concept through production.

• Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Firmware, Mobile, and other engineering teams to define roadmaps and execute against ambitious goals.

• Drive technical direction while empowering engineers to make architectural decisions.

• Foster a culture of engineering excellence through thoughtful code reviews, design discussions, testing, and operational discipline.

• Help build highly reliable, observable, and scalable distributed systems that power millions of real-time events.

• Improve engineering processes, execution, and team health while maintaining a high quality bar.

• Participate in hiring and help build an exceptional engineering organization.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in Python, Go, or React

• 1+ years managing software engineers.

• Experience building production software across both frontend and backend systems.

• Strong software architecture and system design skills.

• Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large cross-functional technical projects.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain exceptional engineers.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Accou

title: Photography Evaluators: Paid Task on Image Quality and Brand Guidelines
description:

We're running a paid study on image quality assessment and brand alignment. This work directly supports our efforts to standardize how visual content is evaluated across different media formats. Establishing a strong baseline for photographic excellence helps us maintain high visual standards moving forward.

HOW IT WORKS

You will begin by completing a structured calibration task focused on evaluating pairs of photographs. During this process, you will judge image quality and check for strict adherence to established brand guidelines. Participants who successfully align with the baseline criteria will then move through an onboarding flow for further tasks. The entire process takes place remotely on your desktop.

WHO THIS IS FOR

We welcome professional photographers, visual designers, photo editors, and brand specialists who have strong opinions on image composition. The ideal candidate has experience working with brand style guides and can articulate exactly why one image works better than another. We are looking for individuals with a sharp eye for detail who are comfortable applying rigid visual criteria to subjective media.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Evaluate pairs of photographs to determine which best meets specific quality standards

- Assess various images for strict adherence to provided brand guidelines

- Complete a remote calibration task to demonstrate your visual assessment skills

- Participate in a brief onboarding process upon successful completion of the initial task

WHO SHOULD APPLY

- Professional experience in photography, graphic design, or visual media assessment

- Strong understanding of image quality metrics (lighting, composition, focus)

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Heidelberg
description:
Du hast noch nie im Vertrieb gearbeitet, würdest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlangen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei uns lernst du Vertrieb von Grund auf und baust dir dein eigenes Netzwerk in deiner Region auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Virtual Property Manager
description:
We're looking for a Virtual Property Manager to oversee day-to-day operations across a growing residential real estate portfolio. You will be the operational point of contact for tenants, vendors, and contractors - managing maintenance coordination, rent collection follow-ups, leasing support, move-ins and move-outs, and all the documentation and communication that keeps a multi-property portfolio running cleanly.
This role has a hard language requirement. You must be fully fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken. A significant portion of tenant and vendor communication happens in Spanish and there is no workaround for this. If you are highly organized, genuinely bilingual, comfortable handling difficult conversations professionally, and take pride in keeping operations tight across multiple moving parts, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires availability during US Pacific Time business hours

• Work directly with ownership on a growing residential portfolio with real operational ownership

• Stable, long-term role with clear responsibilities and room to grow as the portfolio scales

What You'll Work On
Tenant Communication and Support

• Respond to tenant inquiries via phone, text, email, and WhatsApp in both English and Spanish

• Handle difficult tenant conversations professionally and with a solutions-first approach

• Communicate with Section 8 and Housing Authority representatives as needed

• Assist with leasing coordination and tenant screening

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

• Coordinate maintenance requests and follow up with vendors and contractors through to resolution

• Track open work orders and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

• Help source and manage vendors for repairs and renovations

• Escalate urgent property issues quickly and keep ownership informed

Leasing and Turnover Operations

• Coordinate move-ins, move-outs, inspections, and unit turnovers

• Assist with rent collection and payment follow-ups

• Maintain organized property records, leases, invoices, and tenant documentation

Systems, Reporting, and Automation

• Keep property management software, spreadsheets, and internal systems accurate and up to date

• Support ownership with operational reporting and administrative tasks

• Apply a fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting including tracking income, expenses, intercompany transactions, and financial activity across multiple LLCs and properties

• Use AI tools and automation platforms to improve efficiency and streamline recurring workflows

What You Bring

• Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken - this is a non-negotiable requirement

• Prior experience in property management, real estate operations, or a closely related role

• Fundamental understanding of multi-entity accounting and tracking financial activity across multiple properties or business entities

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple open items simultaneously without dropping the ball

• Excellent communication and follow-through across phone, text, email, and messaging platforms

• Comfortable handling difficult tenant conversations professionally and calmly

• Experience coordinating maintenance vendors and contractors

• Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

• Available to work during US Pacific Time business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience with DoorLoop, Buildium, or similar property management software

• Experience working with Section 8 or affordable housing programs

• Experience managing remote vendors or contractors across multiple properties

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12 Time

Position Summary

Natera is seeking an Associate Director, Billing Strategy - Denials & Appeals to lead the strategy, performance, and optimization of denied claims and appeals. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for shaping denial management strategy, driving payer advocacy, and partnering cross-functionally to improve reimbursement outcomes.

This role will also play a key part in supporting automation initiatives across denial and appeals workflows-translating operational expertise into system logic and partnering with engineering and vendors to scale processes through technology.

The Associate Director will oversee this function from three angles:

• Operational: Oversight and performance management of outsourced RCM teams handling denials and appeals.

Strategy & Payer Advocacy

• Act as an internal expert on payer policies and medical necessity criteria for laboratory testing.

Operations & Root Cause Analysis

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work by transitioning denial and appeal processes toward scalable, low-touch or unattended workflows.

• Proactively identify edge cases, failure points, and gaps in automation logic before and after deployment.

Required

title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
description:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.
You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.
This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.
Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.
Responsibilities

• Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases

• Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process

• Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough

• Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)

• Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback

• Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right

• Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most

• Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality

• Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output

• Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report

• Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

• 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions

• Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two

• Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence

• Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)

• Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines

• Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one

• Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high

• Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs

title: Vice President FP&A
description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

This role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into financial priorities, build scalable FP&A capabilities, influence senior stakeholders through data-backed recommendations, and create the systems, routines, and team structure needed to support a high-growth CPG business.
You will be expected to balance strategic vision with operational discipline, bringing strong judgment, executive presence, and a clear point of view to ambiguous and high-impact business decisions.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As an Engineering Manager, Issuing Platform, you’ll lead one or more teams building and operating the core systems behind Airwallex’s issuing products, including card lifecycle management, high-throughput transaction processing, and clearance, settlement, and dispute workflows. You’ll combine people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership to help your teams build reliable, scalable systems for high-stakes financial workflows.

You’ll remain technically credible and engaged at an architectural level while focusing primarily on team health, execution, and long-term technical quality rather than acting as the primary individual contributor. You’ll partner with product, operations, senior engineers, and other engineering leaders to improve reliability, observability, security, developer productivity, and cost efficiency across the platform.

- Own team health, execution, and long-term technical quality across one or more engineering teams.

- Build a strong engineering culture through coaching, feedback, performance management, career development, hiring, and onboarding.

- Drive technical direction and architectural guidance for scalable, resilient transaction-processing systems.

- Improve system design, code quality, testing, reliability, observability, security, and operational excellence across the platform.

- Partner with product, operations, senior engineers, and other engineering leaders to align technical and delivery strategy with business priorities.

- Guide pragmatic technology and platform decisions that balance innovation, stability, developer productivity, and cost efficiency.

This is an in-office role - you’ll be in our Singapore office five days a week.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years in a people leadership role managing engineers directly.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- Strong background in modern backend development using languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.

- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale, distributed, production systems.

- Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals and object-oriented design principles.

- Hands-on experience with event-driven and streaming architectures, for example Kafka.

- Experience designing and operating RESTful APIs at scale.

- Cloud experience with GCP (preferred) or AWS, including containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

- Familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as Splunk, Grafana, and Prometheus.

- Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead the execution of technical and delivery strategy.

Preferred

- Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated financial domains.

- Deep experience with JVM-based ecosystems, including Java or Kotlin with Spring or Spring Boot.

title: Customer Solutions Engineer, EMEA
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Ireland

About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

What you will do 

• Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.

• Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.

• Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.

• Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.

• Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.

• Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.

• Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.

• Surface patterns across engagements

title: Senior Post Producer (m/w/d)

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: Director of Demand Generation

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

Your Impact

As our Director of Demand Generation , you’ll support the Marketing team by owning the global strategy and execution for generating pipeline across our target enterprise accounts. Leading a multi-disciplinary team spanning Digital Marketing, ABX, Field & Regional Marketing, Corporate Events, and Web Experience, you will partner closely with Sales and Revenue Operations to turn demand into predictable revenue.

You will:

• Strategic Growth Leadership: Design and execute an integrated, multi-channel global demand engine aligned with corporate ARR targets, market expansion goals, and key enterprise ICPs.

• Team Scaling & Management: Lead, mentor, and expand a high-performing global team across ABX, Field Marketing, Digital, Web, and Events-fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and commercial excellence.

• Pipeline Acceleration & ABX: Architect targeted Account-Based Marketing strategies for enterprise accounts, driving both net-new logos and expansion within existing accounts across North America, EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.

• Full-Funnel Optimization: Establish a rigorous, data-driven approach to track end-to-end conversion rates, pipeline velocity, CAC, ROMI and marketing-attributed/influenced pipeline across all channels.

• Sales & GTM Alignment: Serve as a core partner to Global Sales leadership, unifying marketing targets with sales pipelines, optimizing lead-to-opportunity handoffs, and continuously aligning GTM execution.

• Leverage AI to Build for Scale: Identify opportunities to scale marketing programs and outcomes by implementing new ways-of-working supported by AI capabilities.

• Budget & Performance Ownership: Manage the global demand gen budget, making agile resource-allocation decisions backed by ROI analytics and attribution models.

This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Boston or London office. 

What Sets You Apart

You're a creative problem-solver and systems builder who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.

Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.

You bring:

• Enterprise B2B Software Track Record: 10+ years of progressive demand generation leadership in enterprise B2B SaaS/software (experience in headless/composable commerce, middleware, or developer-centric infrastructure is a major plus).

• Global Team Leadership: Proven experience leading and inspiring remote, cross-functional GTM teams across multiple regions and time zones.

• Advanced ABX & Digital Native: Mastery of modern enterprise GTM plays, multi-touch attribution, data analytics, and modern martech stacks (CRM, Marketing Automation, Intent Data engines).

Creamos un Entorno Abierto ( Create an Open Environment ) basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

title: Független Értékesítő - Szekszárd
description:
Helló! Mi vagyunk a Teya.
A Teya egy fizetési- és szoftverszolgáltatásokat nyújtó vállalat, londoni központtal. Célunk a kis- és közepes méretű, helyi vállalkozások támogatása Európa-szerte. 2019-es alapításunk óta olyan könnyen használható, integrált eszközöket fejlesztünk, amelyek segítik partnereinket a fizetések egyszerű elfogadásában, és hozzájárulnak üzleti teljesítményük javításához.

A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Legyél a történetünk része!
Kivételes tehetségeket keresünk, akik csatlakoznának küldetésünkhöz. Nálunk lehetőséged van valódi hatást gyakorolni egy lendületes, összetartó közösségben. Támogatunk a folyamatos fejlődésben, büszkék vagyunk közös céljainkra, és átfogó juttatási csomagot kínálunk.

Csatlakozz csapatunkhoz, mint független értékesítő!

Proaktív személy vagy, aki szeret emberekkel beszélgetni és sok időt tölteni terepen? Kiváló kommunikációs készségeid vannak és szereted az értékesítést? Széles kapcsolati hálóval rendelkezel a vendéglátásban, kiskereskedelemben és a szépségiparban, vagy egyszerűen csak ismersz valakit szinte bármire?

A Teya-nál folyamatosan keressük azokat a független értékesítőket, akik képviselik szolgáltatásainkat kis- és középvállalkozások számára a fizetési megoldások területén.
A feladat egyszerű: találj egy ügyfelet, küldj neki ajánlatot, vidd fel felhasználóként, és a jutalék hamarosan a számládon landol.

Van saját céged vagy egyéni vállalkozásod? Remek! A vállalkozásod a hónap során általad hozott ügyfelek után számláz a Teya felé, így a bevételed teljes mértékben az általad elért eredményektől függ.

Miért dolgozz velünk:

- Rugalmasság: Dolgozz a saját feltételeid szerint, kezeld a saját időbeosztásod és határozd meg a prioritásaid

- Korlátlan kereseti lehetőség: Teljesítményalapú, magas jutalékrendszer, korlátlan potenciállal

- Függetlenség: Szabadság a saját vállalkozásod vezetésére, miközben igénybe veheted támogatásunkat és erőforrásainkat

- Kiváló megoldások: Dolgozz a legmodernebb kártyaelfogadó technológiával és POS eszközökkel

- Képzés és támogatás: Részletes képzést biztosítunk, hogy minél jobban megismerd szolgáltatásainkat, és folyamatos támogatást nyújtunk minden felmerülő kérdésre

Amit tőled várunk:

- Kiváló kommunikációs és prezentációs készségek

- Önálló munkavégzés és hatékony időgazdálkodás

- Ambíció, motiváció és könnyedség másokkal való kapcsolattartásban

- Ügyfélszerzés, termék- és szolgáltatásbemutatás, valamint sikeres értékesítés

- Előnyben részesülnek azok a jelöltek, akik terepi vagy személyes értékesítési tapasztalattal rendelkeznek, illetve széles kapcsolati hálóval a kiskereskedelem, vendéglátás és kapcsolódó ágazatok területén

Ha mindez jól hangzik, és szeretnél a saját feltételeid szerint dolgozni korlátlan kereseti lehetőséggel, örömmel várjuk jelentkezésedet!

A Teya elkötelezett az egyenlő esélyek biztosítása mellett.
Elkötelezettek vagyunk egy befogadó munkahelyi környezet kialakítása mellett, ahol mindenki, függetlenül származásától, nemi identitásától, szexuális irányultságától, életkorától, akadályoztatottságától, vallásától vagy hátterétől, kibontakozhat és a legjobbat hozhatja ki magából. Hisszük, hogy a sokszínű csapat kreatívabb ötletekhez, jobb eredményekhez és egy támogatóbb munkahelyhez vezet mindenki számára.

Ha a jelentkezési folyamat bármely szakaszában szükséged lenne bármilyen jellegű támogatásra vagy segítségre,

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato .

YOUR ROLE
You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.
Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.
We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.
By the end of your first year:

• Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier

• Carrier conversion data running in production models

• Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale

• A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions

• Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives

• Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

• 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact

• Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.

• You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included

• You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift

• You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view

• Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

• Real ad budget spent in live auctions

• Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems

• Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms

• Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration

• Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior

• AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker

• CI/CD deployment

• Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

• Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

• Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

title: Library Characterization Engineer

Job description
We are currently looking for a Library Characterization Engineer responsible for the characterization of standard cell and custom cell libraries and generation of the latest library formats with cutting edge tools and methodologies. You will be part to the team developing state-of-the-art digital libraries allowing best-PPA digital design mainly dedicated for automotive market.
Your Role:

• Develop best-in-class library characterization production flow to meet advanced customers requirement. Responsible for timing and power characterization and generation of standard cell EDA views by implementing and maintaining cell characterization tools and flows for the most advanced silicon modeling methodologies.

• Support the First Time Right of IC Designs by ensuring high quality library deliverables. Support liberty model accuracy validation. Develop automatic QA flow including EM/IR and design checks.

• Work closely with the digital library team and support advanced circuit design and modeling, pushing the boundary of what is possible in power, performance, and area.

• Explore innovative modeling techniques for comprehending variation, layout-dependent effects, aging, simultaneous switching, etc.

• Release of digital libraries on our customers portal following standards.

• Work in an international and globally distributed team of experts.

• Customer support for Static Timing Analysis and Signoff condition recommendations.

Your Profile:

• Bachelors Degree or higher in Electronics Engineering.

• Minimum 2 years of working experience in digital design activity, ideally in library characterization with spice, internal tools, or commercial tools such as Liberate and static timing analysis with Primetime or Tempus.

Skills/Competencies:
Behavioral Competencies:

• Good communication skills good level in English, written and spoken.

• Teamwork and collaboration skills, working within multinational, multisite team.

• Open, curious in new design implementation, integrity and friendly when engaging internal/external customers.

• Self-motivated, progressive attitude, and able to work independently with minimum supervision.

Technical/ Functional Competencies:

• Understanding of digital standard cells, digital circuits & optimization for best-PPA.

• Understanding of Timing/Power characterization & modeling of Standard cell circuits. Knowledge of industry standard hardware design CAD software and required standard cell design view generation and validation.

• Ideally, in-depth understanding of Liberty format (NLDM, CCS, CCSN) and transistor level spice simulation. Hands-on experience running SPICE simulations and high sigma variation analysis.

• Knowledge of static timing, power, EMIR analysis using EDA tools.

• TCL, Perl, Python, and/or Shell scripting skills are a plus.

• Good layout design knowledge & parasitic optimization in various types of layouts.

title: Platform Security Engineer
description:

In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive.

The Role
ITHAKA is seeking a Platform Security Engineer to help mature our DevOps capabilities into DevSecOps by embedding security into software delivery, infrastructure, and developer workflows.
This role focuses on building practical engineering capabilities that help teams identify, prioritize, and remediate security risks more quickly and consistently. Rather than relying on one-off manual efforts, the Platform Security Engineer will improve automation, integrate security tooling into existing workflows, and help make secure practices the default way of working. In this role, you will partner with engineers, architects, and platform stakeholders across ITHAKA to reduce security risk through automation, standardization, and developer enablement.
This role reports to the Associate Director, Product Engineering and is a member of the Technology Enabling Services team. The role works in close partnership with the Chief Architect through a dotted-line relationship that provides technical direction, architectural guidance, and alignment on enterprise security strategy.
Responsibilities

• Build and improve engineering workflows and tooling for vulnerability management across applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure.

• Advocate for integration of security checks and policy controls into software delivery pipelines and day-to-day developer workflows.

• Improve dependency management and package governance so teams can address software exposure consistently and sustainably.

• Help evaluate, implement, and tune security tooling includingSAST, DAST, SCA, secret scanning, and related platform controls.

• Build automation that reduces repetitive manual remediation work and speeds up secure delivery.

• Partner with engineering teams to design and promote secure-by-default patterns, templates, and guardrails.

• Work with engineers and technical leaders to triage findings, prioritize risks, and translate them into practical remediation plans.

• Contribute to secure software development lifecycle practices, documentation, and internal guidance that align with how ITHAKA teams build and operate systems.

• Measure the effectiveness and adoption of security controls and recommend practical improvements over time.

Experience and Skills

• 3-5 years of experience in security engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role.

• Hands-on experience implementing security tooling and controls in modern software delivery environments.

• Experience with vulnerability management, dependency management, package governance, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with CI/CD, source control workflows, infrastructure automation, and cloud-based application environments.

• Ability to write scripts or automation to improve security processes and reduce manual effort.

title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, United Kingdom
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, United Kingdom
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in the United Kingdom. Day rate: GBP 400 a day, inside IR35. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. In this role you’ll evangelize Jamf by developing meaningful relationships with key stakeholders at accounts, bridge the gap to executives, and elevate Jamf mindshare to a strategic position within a specific territory.  Your efforts will lead directly to the sales of our Whole Product Experience (WPE), development of pipeline growth, and territory sales.  The Account Executive is an integral part of our inside’s sales organization working closely with our Sales Development Representatives and Sales Engineers to grow new business.  As a member of the Jamf family, you will contribute to our high energy, collaborative, and fun environment.

Please note that we are only able to consider applicants who are currently based in the Minneapolis, MN.

• Manage the entire sales-cycles from prospecting to closing, often presenting to various levels within the organization to demonstrate the value of our full suite of solutions

• Work in partnership with Sales Development Representatives to build pipeline and contribute to their success within Jamf

• Understand the needs of our customers and work in partnership with Sales Engineers to architect solutions to ensure our customers success

• Build trusting relationships within the sales ecosystem including Channel Partners and Apple

• Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Clari, Groove, ZoomInfo , LinkedIn Navigator, and much more

• Minimum of 1 year experience in a sales role (Required)

• Proven track record of generating pipeline and consistently meeting/exceeding revenue targets

• Ability to articulate technical concepts and lead solution-focused sales conversations

• Familiarity with the Apple Ecosystem, but not required.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

• HS Diploma / GED Degree (Required)

• 4 Year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

• A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

• Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

title: Direct Response Video Editor in Mexico - Fully Remote
description:
We’re hunting for a talented direct response video editor and static designer who can craft paid media ads (video and static) that stop the scroll and sell. O’Connell Digital Media Group is an Inc. 5000 direct-response agency that has managed hundreds of millions in profitable ad spend for some of the top direct-response advertisers in the world. You’ll join a veteran team of account directors, media buyers, creative strategists and video editors who share a common goal: generate clicks that convert into high ROAS sales and scale ad spend.
So, if you’re obsessed with performance ads that convert, have edited at high volume in an agency or fast-scaling in-house team, and…

• You LOVE taking a script and seeing the finished ad in your head before you open Premiere…

• You LOVE building the first three seconds that stop the thumb…

• You LOVE sweating the B-roll, the text, the music and the sound until the story lands…

• You LOVE using AI tools to make ads that were impossible a year ago…

• You LOVE seeing the numbers on your ads and finding out why one won…

… then please keep reading as you may be the perfect fit.
Especially if you’re tired of assembly-line edits with no feedback on what worked… tired of the freelance hustle chasing your next project… or stuck inside a single brand, cutting the same content over and over.
Note: Please do not apply if your editing experience is limited to weddings, corporate video, organic social or YouTube content, or to stitching UGC clips into a template.
What Are the Key Points?

•
Core Compensation: $1,750 - $2,000 USD per month

•
Location: 100% remote

•
Hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday (adjustable for those outside the US)

•
Position: Full-time contractor

•
Culture: Accountable, transparent and obsessed with performance

•
#1 Objective: Deliver ads that convert, on time, on spec and on quality

Note: For those applying outside the US, hours may be adjusted to a heavily overlapping schedule we agree on together.
Who Will You Report To?
Hello, my name is Tom Clayson, Head of Creative at O'Connell Media, and I need your help.
I joined O'Connell Media just under a year ago to transform the creative team into one that can scale to meet the projected client growth demands. Our video editors work in small pods, each led by an Editing Team Lead, and with most of the heavy lifting done, I’m now expanding the editing team for the next leg of growth. That’s where you come in.
The volume of ads we need to ship based on our forecast exceeds our current capacity. It’s a good problem to have… but it’s still a problem. I’m hiring editors who can take a strategist’s script and brief and deliver a finished ad that needs no rescue from anyone downstream. You’ll join a pod, work day to day with strategists, and get coaching from me and your team lead along the way.
What’s the Ideal Candidate’s Background?
You’ve been editing direct-response video ads for paid social (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) or YouTube for at least two years, in a high-volume agency or a fast-scaling in-house team. Cutting multiple new ads a week is your normal week. You’ve edited for supplement, health or wellness offers that drive traffic to long-form funnels like VSLs and advertorials and/or performance-based e-comm funnels.
You’re an expert in Premiere Pro. After Effects is a strong plus and Photoshop. Plus you’re deeply comfortable with AI in the edit: digital twins, voice cloning, video cloning, AI-generated B-roll and images, and AI captioning. We don’t force a single tool (Higgsfield is our main AI platform today), but we want to know exactly which tools you’re proficient in and what you’ve made with them.
Most importantly… you edit for marketing, not for content. You know the first three seconds decide whether anyone sees the rest. You understand the structure of a persuasive ad, from hook to problem to mechanism to proof to offer to call to action, and you cut so the viewer never has a reason to leave. Yo

title: Staff Systems Engineer, Simulation Systems Verification and Validation Lead
description:
Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities. Simulation lets us test our driving software against far more scenarios than we can drive on public roads. For simulation results to count toward our safety case, we must show how closely the simulator matches reality and how much uncertainty the remaining difference adds to our safety metrics.
We are seeking a Simulation Systems Verification and Validation (Sim VnV) Lead to own that work across the full autonomy stack. You will define how to validate simulation at the sensor, perception, planning, and full-pipeline levels, lead the cross-functional program that executes the sim VnV program, and turn the results into clear evidence about when and where simulated miles can support safety clearance decisions. You will work closely with simulation, perception, planning, hardware, safety, data science, and systems engineering teams. This is a highly visible, technical leadership role on the critical path to safely scaling our service.
The ideal candidate demonstrates systems thinking, can lead a complex program across teams, and knows how to validate a model of a closed-loop system that has an AI controller inside it.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

Are you a video editor who uses Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro regularly? We’re looking for experienced editors to record themselves working on short editing projects.
Here’s how it works:
1. 🎥 Edit a short project (30-90 minutes).
2. 🖥️ Record your screen while you work using a tool we provide.
3. 📁 Use project files we provide. No client files or personal footage needed.
4. 💰 Get paid for every approved hour of recording.

Work from home, on your own schedule!

You're a great fit if you:
✅ Have 2+ years of professional video editing experience (YouTube, ads, social media, corporate, or film).
✅ Regularly use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. CapCut Pro is welcome as a backup.
✅ Have a capable PC or Mac and a stable internet connection.
✅ Feel comfortable explaining your workflow in English.

title: Principal (European Competition practice)
description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role - especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews - but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Staff Engineer, you'll own the architecture, agents and skills that let every builder in your tribe ship sound, well-architected work without waiting on a handoff, at a moment when Mews has moved almost entirely to an agentic-first engineering model. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. title: Culture Ambassador and Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
Our US partner is a dynamic, growing commercial furniture dealership based in New York City. They specialize in creating high-quality work environments for small to mid-sized businesses. They help companies thrive by delivering innovative, functional, and aesthetically driven workspace solutions.
This is a culture-first role. We are seeking a Culture Ambassador & Executive Assistant to the CEO who will take ownership of building and maintaining a connected, engaged, and positive company culture while also providing executive support. This person will report directly to our CEO and will work closely with our Finance/HR Coordinator.
This is a full-time role , on a US shift and on a Work From Home set-up.
If you have the right skill set, this may be your opportunity to enter this fast-growing organization.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Culture Ambassador

• Lead and evolve company culture initiatives for a fully hybrid team

• Plan and host virtual team-building activities, celebrations, and recognition moments

• Create strong connections between New York and Philippines team members

• Reinforce company values through communication, rituals, and shared experiences

• Support onboarding and employee engagement initiatives

• Partner closely with the Finance/HR Coordinator on employee experience and engagement

Executive Assistant to the CEO

• Provide administrative and operational support to the CEO

• Manage calendars, priorities, reminders, and follow-ups

• Coordinate internal communication across time zones

• Prepare proposals and internal documents in e-Manage (OFH proprietary ERP)

• Comfortable calculating gross profit/margins and vendor discounts

• Track action items, deadlines, and accountability

LinkedIn & Brand Support

• Assist with CEO on company LinkedIn content drafting and organization

• Help share team wins, culture moments, and company milestones

• Support a consistent, professional brand voice

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related field

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in culture, operations, executive assistance, or coordination roles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Strong organizational skills, with a high level of discretion and attention to detail

• Proven ability to work closely and professionally with senior leadership

• Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn and navigate internal systems such as e-Manage
